info.description: An editorial staff account for the handle.epapers admin app (edition ingest management) — completely separate from api::epaper-user, which is for readers. Provisioned manually in Strapi admin; there is no self-registration.

email.description: Must end in @newvision.co.ug — enforced both here (lifecycle) and at the login-request endpoint, so a record can't be created with the wrong domain by mistake either.

passwordHash.description: bcrypt hash of the admin's real password — the first authentication factor. Never returned by any API response; verified via bcrypt.compare, never stored or compared as plain text.

active.description: An inactive admin can never complete login, even with a correct token — set false to revoke access without deleting the record (keeps IngestLog attribution intact).

tokenHash.description: bcrypt hash of the current pending SECOND-FACTOR login token (alphanumeric, emailed after password verification succeeds) — never the plain code. Cleared after successful verification or expiry.

tokenVersion.description: Bumped on every successful login — embedded in the issued JWT, so an older token for this admin can be invalidated (e.g. by an admin forcing re-login) by bumping this without needing a token blocklist.
